title: Passional of Christ and Antichrist & Antithesis of the Life of Christ and Antichrist in Pictures
summary: On the 500th anniversary of its publication, this new edition and translation of the German Passional of Christ and Antichrist and the Latin Antithesis of the Life and Antichrist in Pictures sheds new light on the origins and impact of one of the most striking pieces of Reformation propaganda.
